additional_info.subject: ID0469605-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RN 313405951010] Screen Not Working CRM:00263000319
additional_info.body:
Dear
Şahin Seyhan
,
We are sending this email regarding a problem with your charger:
Uray Petrol
which led to the opened ticket:
0469605
.
Problem description:
"
Although the station is energized, the screen remains black.
We kindly request your support to investigate this issue."
Investigation:
The charger have been checked:
It was possible to observe that the charger was in power safe mode, this means the main circuit breaker of the charger was opened in order to decrease the reactive power produced by the charger.
The HMI will typically show an authentication screen when the charger exits Power Saving Mode and is ready to start a charging session.
A reboot have been performed, however the power save mode still active. The ticket will be moved to our expert team that will help you as soon as possible.
We really appreciate your help and look forward to getting this sorted out soon!
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
